name: dspic33ep128gm604
description: Microchip dsPIC33EP128GM604 (16-bit motor-control DSC, 44-pin, 70 MIPS, 128 KB flash, 16 KB RAM, high-speed PWM, QEI, op amps, CTMU, PTG): XC16 toolchain, Renode CPU.dsPIC33 core (dsPIC33E model)

image.notes: program word at ISA address a sits at 0x01000000 + 2a, 4 bytes (24-bit instruction + phantom byte), the byte layout of XC16 HEX files

renode.notes: dsPIC33E motor-control part: configuration words in flash at ISA 0x0155F0 (load both hex2prog images), ports A-C at 0x0E00, pin select RP/RPI n = 16 x port + pin. High-speed PWM 'pwm' ('pwm Frequency 1', 'pwm DutyCycle 1', 'pwm RisingEdges 0'; PWMLOCK fuse: write IOCONx/FCLCONx with __builtin_write_PWMSFR), QEI 'qei1 Move <counts>' / 'qei1 Index', op amps/comparators 'cmp' (op amp outputs go to their ADC channels), 'ctmu ChargeTime', PTG 'ptg'. ADC inputs 'adc1 SetVoltage <uV> <AN>'. Generated by tools/dspic30/gen_platform33e.py; docs: tools/dspic30/PERIPHERALS_33E.md.

reference.simulator: sim30 device dspic33epsuper (tools/dspic30/difftest.py --family 33e); sim30 is wrong for nested DO, CPBxx targets, CP #lit8 flags, MUL to an accumulator and page-register reads, which tests/dspic33e/cpu33e.c checks against DS70157
